attributes.context: Article VI vacancy and reassignment provisions surrounding a new machine position; reassignment is handled through the supervisor and governed by seniority and qualifications.

extraction_text: When Section 2-A of this Article is invoked to fill a position of a new machine or assignment within an existing classification within a particular department, then employees within such classification within the department may request reassignment through their supervisor. Such reassignments will be based on seniority and qualifications.

attributes.context: This is in Article VII, Section 8, Job Security Benefits, and the surrounding text states that the benefit lasts for 52 weeks after the reduction, requires one year of seniority at the time of the assignment giving rise to the benefit, is computed from the employee’s average basic hourly rate over the last four pay periods, and is paid on a pay-period basis as part of wages.

extraction_text: Eligibility for Job Security Benefits will arise when: 1. An employee, with one (1) year or more of seniority, is reduced from his seniority classification as a result of the permanent discontinuance of work directly attributable to subcontracting or the introduction of new technology into the plant, or 2. An employee, with one (1) year or more of seniority, is reduced from his department as a direct result of 1. above.
